none: PAS NLM-BFE81D: Roman Coin: Tetrarchic Nummus fragment
contea di ritrovamento: North Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy coin fragment. Large module Tetrarchic nummus, probably a Genio Populi Romani issue of 294-313, Reece period 15. Obverse description: Head laureate right, short trimmed beard. Reverse description: Genius standing left holding cornucopiae and cloak, right hand outstretched, A * in field. Reverse inscription: [GENIO POPVLI ROMANI]. Diameter (in excess of): 20mm, Weight: 2.11gms, die axis: 6
